overview: S3C is the single-row scoreboard mutation, and no anticheat flags it. The only live consumer is Shard's monitor, which renders its status sidebar by emitting the scoreboard family itself, including the S3C row updates. The rest of the corpus is registrations (Negativity PacketType SCOREBOARD_SCORE, Artemis PacketRepository SERVER_PLAY+57 with the PacketPlayServerScoreboardScore wrapper and HardcodeMap) and keyword noise: intave's hits handle the sibling S3E team packet and matched on the Scoreboard search term, NCP's CollisionUtil reads the Bukkit scoreboard API for team collision predicates, and amnoah's ReloadCommand mentions BetterScoreboard in a comment.

checks.name: Monitor sidebar bridge (Shard)
checks.purpose: The anticheat's own scoreboard HUD: Shard renders its monitor sidebar by sending the client the scoreboard packets itself, including the S3C row updates.
checks.how_it_works: ScoreboardPacketBridge constructs and sends the full scoreboard family to a viewer: WrapperPlayServerScoreboardObjective for the objective (adventure-component title on 1.20.3+ with a legacy fallback), WrapperPlayServerDisplayScoreboard for the slot binding, and WrapperPlayServerUpdateScore for each row, with CREATE_OR_UPDATE_ITEM carrying the score value and REMOVE_ITEM handling deletions on servers below 1.20.3 (WrapperPlayServerResetScore replaces the remove path on 1.20.3+). updateEntry is the S3C producer: one packet per sidebar row per refresh.
checks.detects: Nothing cheat-related. It is the anticheat as scoreboard producer; keeping the monitor readable is a HUD concern, not a flag.
checks.variations: The rest of the corpus does not read S3C. Negativity and Artemis only register the packet class (SCOREBOARD_SCORE constant, SERVER_PLAY+57 repository entry, wrapper interface); intave's EntityCollisionDisabler and ScoreboardAccessor handle the sibling S3E team packet, matched here only by the Scoreboard keyword.

checks.name: TextComponentScore emulator render (Artemis)
checks.purpose: Render chat score components inside the world emulator by substituting the score value for a named objective and entry.
checks.how_it_works: TextComponentScore is the moderna text-component subclass behind the score placeholder. Its resolve path looks up the objective on the emulated world's Bukkit scoreboard and writes score.getScorePoints() into the value (lines 61-77), and getUnformattedComponentText returns that value. The scoreboard lookup is inside a resolve() method that is commented out in the cloned source, so the class never queries the scoreboard at runtime. The corpus hit is the Scoreboard keyword, not the packet: Artemis reads score state through the server API and never parses S3C.
checks.detects: Nothing. Score text in the emulated chat pipeline only; the renderer substitutes what the server scoreboard already holds, and in the clone even that path is disabled.
checks.variations: None. Artemis's PacketPlayServerScoreboardScore, PacketPlayServerScoreboardObjective, PacketPlayServerScoreboardObjectiveDisplay and PacketPlayServerScoreboardTeam interfaces are repository wrappers only.
